cues.text: The hero's room. Ryoji stands by the window, eyes closed.
He opens his eyes and turns to the hero.
Ryoji smiles and gets up from the bed.
The hero sits with his head bowed.
He stands and steps up to Ryoji.
Ryoji nods and closes his eyes.
He raises his Evoker to his own temple.
Ryoji stands and walks to the middle of the room.
Energy bursts from his chest and engulfs him.
A winged, masked figure floats in his place.
The figure bursts into sparks, and Ryoji stands there again.
